{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royal Hotel''' was a luxurious hotel located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]], that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The hotel was located in a sunny, picturesque location, on a beach. It had tight security and catered for very rich [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officials.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

==History==
During the Galactic Civil War, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Zerex]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] was set to be promoted to [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]], and stayed at the Royal Hotel on the night before his inauguration. Before the ceremony could take place, a group of agents were sent to the hotel by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Draba]] to assassinate Zerex.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
